description: Write acceptance tests for the web module in test/acceptance/web.test.js from .hub/spec.md and the interface JSDoc only (do not read or rely on implementation details). Cover documented behavior, exact strings, error classes and codes, and edge cases. No network: inject fake fetch, sources and routers. Tests may fail until the module is built.
summary: Added test/acceptance/web.test.js: 26 acceptance tests for public/lib.js (bboxParam, formatDistance, formatDuration, nextClickState, buildRouteRequest, summarizePlan) written from the spec and JSDoc only. They fail now against the stubs, as expected; all pass against a literal JSDoc reading. Decisions web-tests.1-3: '1.0 km' at 1000 m, '1 h 0 min' for whole hours, same = value equality of points.
title: Acceptance tests for browser helpers in public/lib.js
